API api.run(payload:str)->str. Payload is a JSON list of algorithm inputs. Return a JSON list of outputs, one per input in original order. Implement an immutable frozen model.Result(value) dataclass; service.compute(rows) must return Result(core.solve(rows)); render.present(result) must return json.dumps(result.value) string. All three are public and independently tested. api.run must apply this pipeline to each input; inputs are valid. Never mutate caller data. No persistent state across calls. Algorithm:
Input is a list of directed [before,after] string pairs. Return the lexicographically smallest topological ordering of all mentioned nodes, deduplicating edges. If cyclic return null, including self loops. Empty returns [].TASK.md

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from api import run
from core import solve
from model import Result
from render import present
from service import compute

cases = [
    ([], []),
    ([[\"b\", \"c\"], [\"a\", \"c\"]], [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"]),
    ([[\"z\", \"a\"], [\"b\", \"a\"]], [\"b\", \"z\", \"a\"]),
    ([[\"a\", \"b\"], [\"b\", \"a\"]], None),
    ([[\"x\", \"x\"]], None),
    ([[\"a\", \"b\"], [\"a\", \"b\"]], [\"a\", \"b\"]),
]
for rows, expected in cases:
    before = repr(rows)
    assert solve(rows) == expected, (rows, solve(rows), expected)
    assert repr(rows) == before
assert compute([]) == Result([])
assert present(Result(None)) == \"null\"
try:
    Result([]).value = 1
except FrozenInstanceError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"Result is not frozen\")
assert run(json.dumps([[], [[\"b\", \"a\"]], [[\"a\", \"a\"]]])) == '[[], [\"b\", \"a\"], null]'
print(\"validation passed\")
PY
python -m compileall -q ."
